hooks._comment: Auto-format on every file write. Defaults to Prettier for JS/TS projects. Replace the command for other stacks: Python: 'black "$FILE"', Go: 'gofmt -w "$FILE"', Rust: 'rustfmt "$FILE"'. Always exit 0 so a missing formatter doesn't block the tool call.
hooks.command: FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$FILE" ] && [ -f "$FILE" ] && command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1 && npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; exit 0

hooks._comment: Run verify.sh and doc-drift check after every turn. Always exits 0 (advisory). See .claude/hooks/stop.sh.
